name: Key-controlled two-way latching device
aliases: Key-controlled two-way latching device IEC reference
summary: This form identifies a two-way latch using a documented key operation.
description: This form identifies a two-way latch using a documented key operation. A key controls the movement or release of the two-way latching arrangement. Its role is mechanical access/operation, while the associated electrical circuit retains its own contact logic.
Keep key identifiers and device tags consistent with the interlocking schedule. A single keyed-latch graphic cannot describe all exchanges in a multi-key sequence.
readingNotes: Cross-reference the key arrangement and retained mechanism positions.
A keyed latch does not establish a complete trapped-key sequence by itself.
